metric_definitions.outcome: matrix rule of bench/matrix_execute.py: c on error, b on null / [] / "" / {} / hover without contents, else a
metric_definitions.digest: first 16 hex digits of sha256 over the canonical JSON of the answer; completion items sorted first; "empty" for outcome b, null for outcome c
metric_definitions.us: latency of the single request, microseconds (first request on the position, no warm repeat)
metric_definitions.target_kind: cargo target kind from target_kinds.json of the active index variant, by entry path heuristic
metric_definitions.cursor_kind: token under the cursor by the sampler's own regexes: decl:<fn|struct|enum|trait|type>, impl, method_call, path, type_usage, macro, use, let, ident
metric_definitions.cfg_test: line inside a #[cfg(test)] mod block, or the attribute stands directly above it
metric_definitions.comparison: per pair of servers and method: rows with equal outcome and digest, differing rows, outcome transitions first>second, and the first differing rows
metric_definitions.matrix_check: a/b/c per method against the published matrix side of the same server kind, for methods run on as many positions as the matrix
metric_definitions.retry: second answer of the same rust-analyzer process on the rows it first answered b or c (not -32601), asked after the whole pass; outcome, digest, us and error as for the first answer
metric_definitions.matrix: the matrix file the positions come from: its repo_commit against this checkout's HEAD and its ra_version against each rust-analyzer binary run here
metric_definitions.rows_filter: differing: only rows on which some pair of servers differs in outcome or digest; rows_total counts the rows of the full file named in full_file
